scope: Causal connection of contributor capacity/voice attrition -> independent observation and metadata loss -> false confidence -> beneficiary uncertainty and possible self-depletion; not a universal law.

test_plan.design: matched controlled synthetic attrition first; blinded independent fault adjudication; pre/post with equal risk exposure and budget
test_plan.data_safety: No intentional harm or exhaustion to real contributors; no personal health/family/financial data collected in public artifact.

claim_states.claim: Loss of independent coverage reduces heldout true-error recall under matched budget
claim_states.design: Unique observer removed vs matched coverage-preserving replacement
claim_states.prediction: Heldout recall after loss < recall before loss in controlled scope
claim_states.disconfirmer: Loss of duplicate weak observer has no effect or improves precision

claim_states.claim: Reports fall without true error reduction and confidence becomes miscalibrated
claim_states.design: Vary access to reporting while holding seeded fault rate fixed
claim_states.prediction: Internal reports decline while external error rate does not decline
claim_states.disconfirmer: True error rate decreases and calibration is maintained

claim_states.claim: When evaluation relies only on visible warnings, reduced reporting can reward further observer attrition
claim_states.design: Blind allocation policy to ground truth while exposing report-only score
claim_states.prediction: Devaluation of independent reporting channels despite error recurrence
claim_states.disconfirmer: Decisions use independently audited truth and retain warning channels

claim_states.claim: Loss of hard-to-transfer contributors can worsen receiver repair capability
claim_states.design: Retirement/exit simulated; track independent repair by substitutes
claim_states.prediction: Delayed recovery despite stable short-run output
claim_states.disconfirmer: Knowledge transfer and redundancy fully preserve repair capacity

claim_states.claim: Consent-based archives and outside review can preserve error discovery without compulsory labor
claim_states.design: Matched interventions with consent, independent auditor and funded succession
claim_states.prediction: Restored failure recall plus intact contributor exit rights
claim_states.disconfirmer: New process increases burden or fails to preserve coverage

claim_states.claim: Independently governed observers outperform numerous correlated observers under suitable tasks
claim_states.design: Match observer count and budget; vary data/incentive independence
claim_states.prediction: More distinct true faults found independent of shared-source repetition
claim_states.disconfirmer: Correlated group or central evaluation achieves equal/better validated results

release_rule: Do not promote to confirmed harm, proprietary novelty, enforceable compensation or AI provider misconduct without independent evidence.
counterfactual_bias_guard: Observe whether independent failure truth, denominator and actual risk exposure changed; no-report != no-error.
mandatory_exit_right_guard: Loss mitigation cannot compel continued unpaid work or unconsented release of private history.
